newsitem.title: FRANCE: Varig plans more cargo lift from Paris.
newsitem.headline: Varig plans more cargo lift from Paris.

text.p: Brazilian airline, Varig, said it is planning to increase its air cargo capacity from Paris early in 1997.
Varig now operates a DC10 aircraft on a daily passenger route from Paris/CDG to Sao Paulo and Rio which offers cargo an average capacity of 6.5 tonnes per flight.

"While our plans are not yet finalised we do expect to introduce MD11 aircraft on the route during the first quarter of next year which can accomodate around 13 tonnes per flight," a Varig cargo official told Reuters.
The MD11 would operate a minimum of three flights per week on Varig's Paris-Brazil service, the official said.
"There has been under-capacity on services between Paris and Brazil for some time and a bigger aircraft would give us much-needed room for manoeuvre."
Varig's Paris cargo office trucks freight to Amsterdam and Frankfurt on a regular basis where it is transferred on to the airline's full-freighter services to Brazil.
Varig did not envisage launching an all-cargo service from Paris in the foreseeable future, the official added.
"If this was envisaged it would be in the long-term."
Earlier this year, Winfried Uebele, Varig cargo manager, Europe, MidEast and Africa said that the airline forecast a boom in export traffic to South America from France in 1997.
France is lagging behind Germany, Italy and Spain as a key air cargo export market for South America.

Major demand now comes the South American investments of car manufacturers, Volkwagen, Ford and Fiat. About 70 percent of Varig's exports from Europe are automobile related with about 300 European firms involved in the international car parts supply business.
Uebele had said telecommunications could prove to be a major future cargo from Europe to Brazil due to the privatisation of the country's telephone network.

Air France upgraded its full-freighter services from Paris to South America with the introduction of winter schedules adding a third weekly Boeing 747-200F frequency on its Paris-Mexico City 747-200F service with additional frequencies to Buenos Aires and Sao Paulo. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+44 171 542-5017
